approach: Agents of a study job get a tree without the other systems' studies; Athena's own gate does not. Add `Snapshot::create_hiding(..., hidden: &[String])` in athena-git (existing `create` and public `materialize` keep their signatures and mean "full tree"). Hidden directories are dropped at materialization, so they are absent from both sides of the snapshot's diff; `change_list()` also drops stray paths under them and `hidden_writes()` reports those drops; `hidden()` returns the list. `Athena::hidden_study_dirs(ctx)` in run/pin.rs reads the URL of the job's recorded pin and returns every `studies/<d>` at the base whose pin.json URL (normalised) differs or is unreadable; a change job has no pin and hides nothing. The producer snapshot and the verifier AGENT snapshot use it; checks, demonstration reverts and the baseline run on the unhidden tree. Both agents are told in code what the hidden view cannot run: the verifier by a `hidden-study-directories` 'not a check' entry in its checks, the producer by a note prepended to the brief inside `producer_loop` (new this round). The reader hides when the request selects exactly one configured system. If the base's schema has a dedicated way to name a system in a request (a field or fixed syntax), the reader's view is decided from that alone; only when selection is a substring guess does a change reading made in the hidden view get discarded and re-read on the full tree. Last, add the hermes-agent table to athena.toml. Step 1 stops the producer if the base lacks the systems schema; this copy lacks it (no `systems` in crates/athena-data/src/config.rs, no `capabilities.study.systems` in athena.toml, `pin_repo` reads one `[capabilities.study]` section at pin.rs:33-43), so the selector form is unknown to me.

decisions.choice: Keep the gate on the full tree and hide only from the agents. Checks (run/mod.rs:1936-1937 via `verifier_snapshot`), demonstration reverts (run/checks.rs:663) and baseline checks (run/checks.rs:955) call the unhidden functions. `verification_stage` rebuilds the verifier snapshot with `verifier_snapshot_hiding` at the same `verify_dir` straight after destructuring `Checked` (verification.rs:40-50), before `candidate_view` (:58) and `inputs` (:64) are built, replacing `vsnap`, `prepared` and `tool_config_from_base`; the reruns at :313 and :341 use the hiding form too.
decisions.reason: The study check `cargo test --locked` (athena.toml:122-125) must see studies/firstmate-work-handling (athena-cli drain.rs:5017 `include_str!`, tests/drain.rs:6948, xtask site_page.rs:11, cap-study rules.rs:1435), so it runs on the full tree. The swap sits before :58 so the diff view and tool config come from the snapshot the verifier works in. Unchanged from the previous plan.

rejected.why: Touches athena-cli tests, cap-study rules tests and the xtask site generator (site.rs:17); the site is out of scope.

decisions.choice: Choose the directories to hide by the URL of the job's recorded pin (`ctx.job.job.pin`): keep `studies/<d>` whose pin.json `repository_url` equals the pin's `url` after stripping a trailing `/` and `.git`; hide every other directory, including one whose pin.json is missing or not valid JSON. `study_pin`'s exact-match rule (pin.rs:99) stays.

decisions.choice: Reader view (answers finding 3). Step 1 reads the base's systems schema and records which of two cases holds. (A) The schema has a dedicated way to name a system in a request (a field or fixed syntax, not a substring): `reader_hidden_dirs` decides from that alone and `read_for` adds no re-read. (B) Selection is a substring or other guess: `read_for` (reading.rs:472, signature unchanged; callers pin.rs:158, reading.rs:1058, :1263) hides when the shared selector (`study_system_url(config, request) -> Option<String>`, extracted from `pin_repo` only if private) returns exactly one URL, runs the existing logic with `read_once(..., &hidden)`, and if the accepted reading names a capability whose `pins_repo()` is false (looked up in `self.capabilities` as pin_repo does at pin.rs:30) discards it and reads once more with an empty list (seq and spent advanced by the invocations already made, same pattern as reading.rs:496-514). If that full-tree run returns a pinning capability the result is a read failure `(None, invocations, Some("the reader chose a study when it saw only its system's study and a change when it saw all studies; ask again naming the system"))`, never a reading. A declining reading, a reader failure and a study reading made in the hidden view are returned as they are. The final report says which case was found.
decisions.reason: Criterion 2 says a change job's snapshots hold every study, yet the reader picks the capability (reading.rs:719-730, set at :817) after it has its snapshot. With an explicit selector the intent is known before the reader runs and a second run is unnecessary; the correction is only the fallback for a guessed selector. Only the contradiction is a new stop, and it is a read failure (ReadError::Failed path, reading.rs:489 and :648), not a refusal, so no reading is newly refused. Cost in case B: one extra reader run, only for a request that selects one system and is read as a change.

rejected.option: Always re-read, ignoring a dedicated selector
rejected.why: Finding 3: a dedicated form decides the view by itself; the second run is extra cost and an extra failure mode.

rejected.option: Hide all studies from every reader

decisions.choice: `change_list()` drops entries at or under a hidden directory; `Snapshot::hidden_writes()` returns them; the producer loop (producer.rs after :413) prints one `hidden` line naming them. Nothing new goes in the job record.

A stray write is not landed and the owner sees the attempt.

decisions.choice: Answers finding 2 (major). Tell the producer the same thing, in code. In `producer_loop` (producer.rs:265), straight after the `ProducerWork` destructure, shadow `brief` with the brief followed by a `## Study isolation` note whenever `snapshot.hidden()` is non-empty. Every first attempt and every send-back (`attempt_brief` at :286 and the `send_back_text*` calls at :563-580) then carries it. The producer's `hidden` UI line (decision 5) is unchanged. Nothing is added to the stored brief: the note lives in the sent prompt, so ProducerInputs, crates/athena-context/src/briefs.rs and the prompt budgets are untouched.

Placing the note in producer.rs (a listed deliverable) avoids editing run/mod.rs:1150, where the stored brief is built and which is not listed; ProducerInputs.checks (briefs.rs:357) holds only name and command, with no detail field, so a check entry would be a poor fit.

decisions.choice: Criterion 1's firstmate half uses the real file, read at run time (`std::fs::read` of `concat!(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR"), "/../../studies/firstmate-work-handling/pin.json")`, not `include_str!`). decisions.choice: The criterion-3 fixture holds every commit shape the real branch has. Commit-shape table (rule outcome): (1) job commit on visible paths: lands as before; (2) job commit that also writes a hidden path: that entry dropped, rest lands, UI `hidden` line; (3) records-only commit (Athena's own `ask`/dispatch commits under records/, on main in these tests because cutover_job is removed from the fixture config): records/ already absent from snapshots, unchanged; (4) owner-path (athena-exclude) commit: `classify` still hides it, unchanged, not exercised here (existing snapshot.rs tests); (5) intervention commit (a plain commit without an Athena trailer) editing studies/a after it was created: in the base tree, hidden from the study job's reader, producer and verifier-agent snapshots, visible to the gate; lands unchanged with the intervention's bytes; (6) retry-after-block landing (`BaseThenTree`) and kept-dir resume (`BaseThenDir`): seed tree materialized with the same list, so the change list is against the hidden base; covered by the snapshot.rs unit test with BaseThenTree. No landing, history-check or attribution classification function changes.
decisions.reason: Hidden paths never enter the snapshot repository, so classification code never sees them. The criterion-3 test adds the intervention commit between `add_studies` and `ask` and asserts the landed `studies/a` bytes equal the intervention's bytes and the landed diff outside records/ names only README.md. It differs from the real repository in that records live on main in the fixture and not on athena/records. Callers of `change_list`: candidate.rs:34, run/mod.rs:948 and :2254, producer.rs:205, :217, :413 get the same result for an empty list.

rejected.option: Teach landing or the history check about hidden paths
rejected.why: Hidden paths never enter the snapshot repository.

steps: Check the base. Read crates/athena-data/src/config.rs for a `systems` map under the study capability with repo_url and repo_ref, and read `pin_repo` and its callers (pin.rs, run/mod.rs:1088) for how a request selects a system. risks.risk: The base lacks the systems schema, so criterion 1 and the athena.toml entry cannot hold.
risks.mitigation: Step 1 stops the producer if the schema is absent and lands nothing; the plan does not invent it or a selector.

risks.risk: The verifier agent works in the hidden view and may run `cargo test`/`clippy --all-targets` there; tests that read studies/firstmate-work-handling then fail and a wrong rejection could follow via `judge` (verification.rs:396-411).
risks.mitigation: A 'not a check', passed `hidden-study-directories` entry in `inputs.checks` names the hidden directories and says such failures are artefacts of its view while the recorded checks ran on the full tree. The criterion-3 test asserts it for a study job; 2(c) asserts its absence for a change job. The residual risk is a verifier that ignores the entry; it is put to the user.

risks.risk: The producer, which can write, runs the hidden-view tests, sees them fail and edits them (or the files they read) to pass; study admission refuses only build output (cap-study lib.rs:112-124), so the edit would land. (Finding 2.)
risks.mitigation: The `Study isolation` note in every producer prompt and send-back names the failing tests and forbids editing them for this reason; tests 2(b) and 3 assert it. The edits would still run in the gate on the full tree, where a broken test fails the check; the verifier sees the diff. Residual: a producer that ignores the note; put to the user.

risks.risk: The producer note is not in the stored brief (the prediction commit holds the brief built at run/mod.rs:1150), so the record of what the producer was told differs from the sent prompt.
risks.mitigation: The sent prompt already differs from the stored brief by the evidence path (mod.rs:1306). The note is tied to `snapshot.hidden()`, which the job's `hidden` UI line and the verifier brief also show, and tests read the recorded producer prompts.

risks.risk: `cargo test -p athena-cap-study` panics (rules.rs:1435 `expect("a study file")`) inside a study agent's hidden snapshot for a Hermes job.
risks.mitigation: Both notices name this crate; the gate and CI run it on the full tree and decide; listed in dependents and put to the user.

risks.risk: The rebuilt verifier snapshot differs from the one the checks ran in, so the verifier could judge a different tree.
risks.mitigation: Both come from the same base and candidate commits; only hidden directories differ, and the change list never includes them. The rebuild's tree becomes `prepared`, which the snapshot-unchanged check and both reruns compare against. The criterion-3 test lands a job through this path.

risks.risk: A study directory with no readable pin.json is hidden from every study job, including its own system's.
risks.mitigation: Study rules require a pin.json per study. A test commits a study without a pin.json and asserts it is hidden, so the fail-closed rule is fixed.

risks.risk: Case B only: the re-read of a change reading adds a reader run (cost, time) and the second reader could differ from the first in more than the file view.
risks.mitigation: It happens only when the request selects exactly one configured system and the hidden-view reading is a non-pinning capability; `check_budget` (reading.rs:546) applies to the second run; test 2(d) fixes the behaviour. In case A no re-read exists.

risks.risk: A planner or critic of a study job would see all studies.

It parses `include_str!("../../../athena.toml")` with `athena_data::Config::parse` and asserts the hermes-agent system holds repo_url https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent.git and repo_ref v2026.9.24.
